review_candidates.title: Storage Engineer
review_candidates.description: NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information. Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world. Job Description About the Role NBCUniversal has an exciting opportunity for a talented individual to join the Enterprise Technology and Infrastructure Storage team as a Storage Engineer. The team supports Enterprise Technology, Broadcast, Production, and Media Operations systems across NBCUniversal’s global portfolio. The Storage Engineer will be responsible for maintaining and supporting highly available storage and data-protection environments operating 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year. This role will execute and support operational changes across supported platforms and their dependent applications. The engineer will also serve as an escalation point for major incidents requiring storage expertise and will help manage those incidents through resolution. Essential Functions Support the complete lifecycle of NBCUniversal’s enterprise storage technologies, including file, block, object, cloud, and tape storage platforms, both on-premises and in the cloud. Provide Level 2 escalation support to Managed Service Provider teams responsible for maintaining designated storage systems, including participation in a 24x7 on-call support rotation. Investigate application and infrastructure performance issues affecting Media Operations and Enterprise Systems, including their integration points, to identify systemic issues and determine root cause. Troubleshoot complex storage, data-protection, performance, availability, and connectivity issues and coordinate their resolution across internal teams. Work directly with storage vendors to resolve technical issues, manage escalations, and help drive future product improvements and development. Upgrade, patch, and maintain storage systems to improve functionality, stability, performance, and security. Develop and maintain scripts and automation for routine operational, administrative, monitoring, reporting, and provisioning tasks. Partner with engineering teams across compute, networking, database, automation, cybersecurity, cloud, and application support to deliver cross-platform and cross-facility solutions. Support storage-related projects, including system implementations, migrations, technology refreshes, capacity expansions, and decommissioning activities. Follow established incident, problem, change, and configuration-management processes. Provide timely and clearly communicated updates to management, business stakeholders, and technical teams regarding incidents, operational activities, risks, and project deliverables. Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, system diagrams, support runbooks, and knowledge-base articles. Provide system and support-process training to members of the broader engineering, operations, and Managed Service Provider teams. Qualifications Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Minimum of four years of experience supporting and troubleshooting medium-to-large, highly available storage and data-protection environments. Hands-on experience with at least two of the following storage technologies or platforms: NetApp storage systems Dell EMC storage systems, including PowerScale/Isilon Cloudian or other S3-compatible object-storage platforms Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services cloud storage technologies Enterprise LTO tape libraries and archive systems Rubrik backup and data-protection platforms, including Rubrik software and appliances Minimum of four years of experience planning, documenting, validating, implementing, and testing technical solutions within a global enterprise environment. Experience with storage performance analysis, capacity management, data replication, SAN-based backup, load balancing, storage virtualization, and SAN zoning and provisioning. Working knowledge of storage protocols and technologies, including Fibre Channel, iSCSI, SMB/CIFS, NFS, S3, flash storage, RAID, and LTO tape. Experience building, configuring, administering, patching, and troubleshooting Windows and Linux servers. Working knowledge of network infrastructure, protocols, services, and diagnostic toolsets. Experience troubleshooting complex issues across storage, operating system, network, and application layers. Ability to create and maintain accurate technical documentation, operational procedures, and support runbooks. Eligibility Requirements Willingness to travel and work overtime, evenings, or weekends with short notice when operationally required. Ability and willingness to participate in a 24x7x365 on-call support rotation. Ability to support and manage technology environments across multiple locations in the United States and internationally. Desired Characteristics A collaborative team player who can adjust effectively to changing requirements, schedules, technologies, and priorities. Self-motivated, resourceful, and capable of achieving goals independently while also working effectively within cross-functional teams. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to identify root causes and develop sustainable technical solutions. An effective and clear communicator, both verbally and in writing, who can work with highly technical resources, business users, vendors, and management. Ability to communicate complex technical information, operational risks, and project status to management in a clear and easily understood manner. Experience supporting network environments that include both high-bandwidth and bandwidth-constrained infrastructure. Familiarity with DevOps and infrastructure-automation tools and languages, including Bash, Python, PowerShell, Ansible, Terraform, and Git. Familiarity with enterprise monitoring, observability, and logging technologies, including Nagios/OP5, Datadog, and comparable platforms. Experience with Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services cloud storage technologies, including object, file, block, and archive storage, as well as data migration, replication, lifecycle management, security, monitoring, performance optimization, and cost management. Experience supporting hybrid-cloud storage, cloud data migration, object lifecycle management, and cloud-based data-protection solutions. Experience supporting storage platforms for artificial intelligence and machine-learning workloads, including the use of AI-enabled storage and AIOps capabilities for performance optimization, anomaly detection, predictive capacity planning, incident analysis, and operational automation. Familiarity with data-protection, cyber-resilience, recovery testing, and storage-security best practices. Relevant storage, cloud, operating system, networking, or automation certifications are desirable. Previous experience in the media, entertainment, broadcast, or production industry is preferred. Experience administering and supporting Rubrik backup software and appliances, including backup policy configuration, data protection, recovery, replication, archival, monitoring, upgrades, troubleshooting, and vendor support escalation. Additional Information As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require support throughout the application and/or recruitment process as a result of your disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation. You can submit your request to AccessibilitySupport@nbcuni.com.

review_candidates.title: Network & Firewall Engineer (m/w/d)
review_candidates.description: Lohn - CHF95'000 - 125'000 Unser Rocken Partner gehört zu den führenden Anbietern von Transport- und Logistiklösungen. Mit innovativen Services in den Bereichen Fahrzeug-, Lebensmittel-, Pharma- und Cargoverkehr sorgt das Unternehmen täglich für sichere, flexible und pünktliche Lieferungen – national wie international. Das Tätigkeitsfeld umfasst komplexe Logistikprozesse: von der Lagerung über die Kommissionierung bis zur termingerechten Auslieferung. Dabei stehen massgeschneiderte Kundenlösungen und höchste Qualitätsstandards im Mittelpunkt. Modernste Infrastruktur und ein starkes Netzwerk ermöglichen dabei effizienten Rundum-Service. Kurze Wege, direkte Zusammenarbeit und ein ausgeprägter Teamgeist prägen die Arbeitsweise. Eigenverantwortung und Initiative werden grossgeschrieben. Klingt nach einem Umfeld, in dem Du Deine Stärken einbringen möchtest? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen und gemeinsam den nächsten Schritt mit unserem Rocken Partner zu gehen! Rolle Stabile Netzwerke entstehen nicht zufällig, sondern durch saubere Architektur und klare Standards. Als Network & Firewall Engineer verantwortest Du die unternehmensweite Netzwerkinfrastruktur vom Routing über Switching bis zur Firewall-Landschaft. Du arbeitest eng mit System- und Security-Engineers zusammen und bringst technische Themen selbstbewusst auf den Punkt. Dein Wissen gibst Du weiter und prägst damit die Qualität im ganzen Team. Verantwortung Du planst, implementierst und betreibst die Netzwerkinfrastruktur über LAN, WAN und WLAN hinweg. Die Firewall-Landschaft konfigurierst Du, betreibst sie und entwickelst sie laufend weiter. Du analysierst Störungen im Netzwerkumfeld und behebst sie im 2nd- und 3rd-Level-Support. Des Weiteren stellst Du Stabilität, Skalierbarkeit und Verfügbarkeit der gesamten Umgebung sicher. Dokumentationen, Standards und Betriebskonzepte pflegst Du und baust sie gezielt aus. Zudem berätst Du interne Stakeholder bei Netzwerk- und Security-Fragestellungen. Qualifikationen Du bringst einen Bachelorabschluss in Informatik, Engineering oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit. Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Netzwerkumfeld zeichnet Dich aus. Du kennst Dich in mehreren Bereichen wie VPN, VLAN, DNS, Zertifikats-Handling, Routing und Firewalling fundiert aus. Relevante Protokolle inklusive OSPF und BGP beherrschst Du sicher.
